claim: T-DXd (trastuzumab deruxtecan) co-activates ferroptosis via its DXd payload (a camptothecin-class topoisomerase I inhibitor). Mechanistic chain: DXd poisons TOP1mt → mtDNA protein-linked breaks → mitochondrial dysfunction → ROS/lipid peroxidation → ferroptosis sensitization. Concurrent HER2 internalization reduces PI3K-NRF2-SLC7A11 transcription. Tumors with constitutively high SLC7A11 (confirmed TCGA CV=59.4% within HER2-enriched, Q1=104 vs Q3=276 RSEM) escape this window. SLC7A11 IHC stratifies T-DXd responders vs early-resistance patients.
mechanistic_correction: Evaluator noted 'post-translational SLC7A11 suppression' was mechanistically overspecified. Corrected to: PI3K-NRF2-SLC7A11 TRANSCRIPTIONAL downregulation (NRF2 is the transcription factor for SLC7A11 per PMID 30867592) — not post-translational. This is the supported pathway.

slc7a11_her2_heterogeneity.finding: SLC7A11 CV=59.4% within HER2-enriched (Q1=104, Q3=276 RSEM). 2.7-fold IQR spread confirms meaningful high/low subgroups for IHC stratification.

dxd_ferroptosis_mechanistic_chain.key_finding: CPT-11/irinotecan (same pharmacological class as DXd) directly induces ferroptosis via ALOX15/GPX4/SLC7A11 axis with measured lipid peroxidation (PMID 37735740). TOP1mt poisoning by SN-38 causes mtDNA breaks and mitochondrial dysfunction (PMID 31723605).
dxd_ferroptosis_mechanistic_chain.remaining_gap: No study directly tests DXd/exatecan → mitochondrial ROS → ferroptosis. Evidence is by structural class analogy. Ferrostatin-1 rescue in T-DXd-treated HER2+ cells would be the definitive experiment.

evidential_quality.rationale: Two gaps closed: (1) SLC7A11 within-HER2+ heterogeneity confirmed by TCGA (CV=59.4%, n=78) — IHC stratification premise data-supported. (2) Mechanistic chain for topo-I → ferroptosis supported by 5 PMIDs for CPT/SN-38 class (PMID 37735740, 40513923 directly name ferroptosis). Ceiling remains at 0.72 because DXd-specific mechanistic data is absent — class analogy only. Post-translational mechanistic error corrected to transcriptional NRF2-SLC7A11.

plausibility.rationale: Mechanistic overspecification (post-translational) corrected. CPT-class ferroptosis now directly evidenced.
